reader_summary.headline: The opening lines of Charles Dickens, A Tale of Two Cities, offer a fitting coda to 2020.
reader_summary.overview: The opening lines of Charles Dickens, A Tale of Two Cities, offer a fitting coda to 2020. It was the best of times, it was the worst of times. We are left to contemplate the jaw-dropping list of extremes compiled during this turbulent year.

thesis: The transcript reviews the extreme volatility of 2020, characterized by a severe pandemic and recession that were offset by aggressive government intervention and strong capital markets. It argues that while forecasting macroeconomic outcomes is generally unreliable, the current environment offers a distinct opportunity driven by a likely healthy economy, accommodative monetary policy, and significant pent-up consumer demand.
